entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand you sold me is a complete piece of junk. It's not working at all and I want my money back. This is ridiculous.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
A preference issue? Are you kidding me? The thing is broken! It won't sync with the app, the readings are garbage... it's completely defective. I don't want to fix it, I want a refund.

I understand your frustration, sir. It sounds like there might be a connection problem. We have a dedicated technical support team that can troubleshoot that syncing issue with you. They're usually very quick.

I'm not troubleshooting anything! I paid for a product that works, not a project. This is unacceptable. Either you give me a refund right now or I want to speak to your manager. I'm one click away from telling everyone on social media how VeloFit sells broken garbage.
Okay, sir, I understand. No need for that. Please give me just one moment to pull up your order and review our return policy.
Alright, I have your account here. I see the VeloBand was delivered 34 days ago. Let me see... yes, according to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window.
So you're giving me the refund?

Yes, absolutely. Since the item is defective and you're within the timeframe, I can process that for you immediately. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Once our warehouse receives the band, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method.
Fine. That's all I wanted. You should have just done that from the start.
I apologize for the inconvenience, sir. The label is on its way. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
